acceptance: A train merge whose only conflict is docs/research-index.md lands the PR with the regenerated index, and the test is red without the fix
A conflict in a hand-written file still ejects the PR with the conflict brief
docs/operations/wave-operations.md says that the train regenerates derived files
fix: When a train merge stops only on derived files (the set that evolve pr refresh writes), run the same generators, stage the result and continue. Eject only when a hand-written file conflicts.
notes: Evidence: integration batch 1386 1387 rc=1, both ejected with conflict docs/research-index.md.
summary: On 2026-11-10 integration batch 1386 1387 ejected both PRs on a conflict in docs/research-index.md, a generated file. derived.IsDerivedConflict (go/internal/derived/conflict.go:7) has no production caller, so the train never runs the generators that evolve pr refresh runs.
title: The integration train ejects a PR on a conflict in a derived file instead of regenerating it
